plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
database: none of its own: the stores use tables in each product's PostgreSQL database through the product's openvibe-sdk/db handle (ADR-035); DDL from schema(prefix) in the product's migrations
consumers: OpenVibe.Wiki (v1.3.0 on PostgreSQL; public at https://openvibe.wiki)
OpenVibe.Blog (v1.3.0 on PostgreSQL; public at https://openvibe.blog)
OpenVibe.News (v1.3.0 on PostgreSQL; deployed loopback-only, not launched)
OpenVibe.Reviews (v1.3.0 on PostgreSQL; deployed loopback-only, not launched)
OpenVibe.Deals (v1.3.0 on PostgreSQL; deployed loopback-only, not launched)
OpenVibe.Coupons (v1.3.0 on PostgreSQL; deployed loopback-only, not launched)
OpenVibe.Trade (v1.3.0 on PostgreSQL; deployed loopback-only, not launched)
contracts: openvibe-contracts v0.129.0 (devDependency): emits search.index-document@1 and events.event-envelope@1 (validated in tests)
dependsOn: openvibe-shared >=1.5.0 (optional peer; tests pin v2.6.0; layout needs >=2.6.0)
tests: npm test (Node 22): 19 files, 143 cases; test/postgres.test.js runs on PostgreSQL 18 + PgBouncer when OV_TEST_PG_URL is set (CI starts the containers), else it is listed as skipped
deployment: none: a package released as git tags; products pin the tag and deploy it with their own releases
features: async stores on PostgreSQL through openvibe-sdk/db, with the caller's transaction handle, schema(prefix) DDL for migrations, indexes for every query and bounded, keyset-paged lists
revisions with optimistic concurrency, diff and revert
Media attachment references with honest broken states
deterministic indexability gate, redirects, sitemaps and feeds
authorship and AI disclosure, held until a person's review
Search index documents, tombstones and publication events
auto-escaping SSR and a safe Markdown subset

the ingest chassis: the OpenVibe.Sources client, a change cursor + pull loop with per-item savepoint isolation and an {applied|hold|removed} apply contract, a signed event consumer with an exactly-once inbox, the normalisers and PSL/registrable-host and freshness helpers the five content products share
the publication glue: gate → document → sequencer.stamp → events → outbox.enqueue on the caller's transaction handle, tombstones on unpublish/merge, and the IndexNow ping

the page document through openvibe-shared/shell page(): robots and canonical from the gate's decision, article times, prev/next, feeds, app icon, stylesheets, boost marker and the footer init, plus the AI summary (ai-summary meta, WebPage JSON-LD, facts block) when the caller passes summary/facts/updated/url
